[
  {"step": 1, "file": "tests/internal/fuzzers/parser_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 44, "var": "data[0]", "code": "if (GET_MOD_EQ(4,3)) { format = \"logfmt\"; }", "note": "Attacker-controlled first byte (0x03) selects the logfmt parser format."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "tests/internal/fuzzers/parser_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 88, "var": "types", "code": "types[i].type = parser_types[i];", "note": "When the types_str branch is taken (byte 0x05), five parser types are registered; key \"CCC\" is assigned FLB_PARSER_TYPE_BOOL."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "tests/internal/fuzzers/parser_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 130, "var": "fuzz_parser", "code": "fuzz_parser = flb_parser_create(\"fuzzer\", format, ...);", "note": "Parser is created with types_len=5, so typecasting is enabled for parsed keys."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "tests/internal/fuzzers/parser_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 137, "var": "data", "code": "flb_parser_do(fuzz_parser, (char*)data, size, ...);", "note": "Remaining attacker-controlled bytes (log line ending in 'CCC=x') are passed to the parser; 'x' is the final byte of the 107-byte heap input buffer."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/flb_parser.c", "function": "flb_parser_do", "line": 641, "var": "parser->type", "code": "return flb_parser_logfmt_do(parser, buf, length, ...);", "note": "Dispatch to the logfmt parser based on the selected format."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/flb_parser_logfmt.c", "function": "logfmt_parser", "line": 172, "var": "value", "code": "flb_parser_typecast((const char*) key, key_len, (const char*) value, value_len, ...);", "note": "Parses pair 'CCC=x'; value points to 'x' at the very end of the buffer with value_len=1, and key 'CCC' is not null-terminated. Because types_len != 0, typecast is invoked."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/flb_parser.c", "function": "flb_parser_typecast", "line": 899, "var": "val", "code": "if (!strncasecmp(val, \"true\", 4)) { ... else if(!strncasecmp(val, \"false\", 5)){ ... } else { error = FLB_TRUE; }", "note": "val_len is 1, so 'x' matches neither \"true\" nor \"false\"; the BOOL cast fails and error is set to FLB_TRUE."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "src/flb_parser.c", "function": "flb_parser_typecast", "line": 917, "var": "key", "code": "flb_warn(\"[PARSER] key=%s cast error. save as string.\", key);", "note": "key points into the input buffer and is not null-terminated; printf reads it as %s past the end of the 107-byte heap region -> heap-buffer-overflow READ (confirmed by ASAN at flb_parser.c:917)."}
]
EOF
python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('valid json')"` executed with exit code 0.
